# SmartPot

> Smart hydroponic crop monitoring and AI automation platform. Open source under the MIT License.

- Web app: https://smartpot.app/
- API server: https://api.smartpot.app/
- OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec: https://api.smartpot.app/v3/api-docs
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.smartpot.app/mcp
- Organization: https://github.com/SmartPotTech

## Core Capabilities

- **Telemetry & Time Series**: Reads temperature (`temperature`), air humidity (`humidity`), substrate moisture (`soilMoisture`), light (`brightness`), nutrient solution pH (`ph`), nutrient concentration (`tds`), and atmospheric pressure (`atmosphere`) over MQTT v1 into PostgreSQL 17 with TimescaleDB 2.17.2.
- **Supported Species**: `LETTUCE`, `TOMATO`, `STRAWBERRY`, `BASIL`, `SPINACH`, `PEPPER`.
- **Crop Kinds & Container Forms**: Real hardware (`REAL`) or cloud simulator (`VIRTUAL`); container forms `POT`, `NFT`, `TOWER`, `RAFT`.
- **AI Engine (`SmartPot-AI`)**: Combines 21 agronomy expert-system rules, fuzzy-logic health index (`EXCELLENT`, `GOOD`, `FAIR`, `POOR`, `CRITICAL`, `UNKNOWN`), short-horizon trend forecasting, and continual-learning calibration models.
- **Actuator Safety**: Supports `WATER_PUMP`, `UV_LIGHT`, `FAN`, `HUMIDIFIER`, `NUTRIENT_DOSER`, and `PH_DOSER` with command durations capped at 1–3600 seconds and idle/in-flight interlocks.

## MQTT v1 Topic Contract

All device topics use the `smartpot/v1/{cropId}` prefix:

- `smartpot/v1/{cropId}/telemetry` — Device publishes JSON or compact binary v2 sensor readings.
- `smartpot/v1/{cropId}/commands` — Broker delivers actuator commands (`ACTIVATE` / `DEACTIVATE`, optional `durationSeconds`) to the device.
- `smartpot/v1/{cropId}/commands/ack` — Device publishes command execution acknowledgements (`EXECUTED` / `FAILED`).
- `smartpot/v1/{cropId}/status` — Device connection lifecycle status.
- `smartpot/v1/{cropId}/capabilities` — Device declares supported sensors, ranges, and actuators.

## HTTP REST API (`/api/v1`)

Interactive API documentation is served at `/docs` and OpenAPI 3.0.1 JSON at `/v3/api-docs` on `api.smartpot.app`:

- Authentication: `/api/v1/auth/register`, `/api/v1/auth/login`, `/api/v1/auth/logout`, `/api/v1/auth/session`, `/api/v1/auth/password/forgot`, `/api/v1/auth/password/reset`
- Crops & Virtual Devices: `/api/v1/crops`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/automation`, `/api/v1/crops/automation`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/device`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/device/key`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/virtual-device`, `/api/v1/virtual-devices/places`
- Telemetry & Streaming: `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/readings`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/readings/latest`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/readings/summary`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/readings/export`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/stream` (SSE), `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/readings/stream` (SSE)
- Actuators & Commands: `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/actuators`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/commands`, `/api/v1/commands`, `/api/v1/commands/bulk`
- AI & Overview: `/api/v1/crop-profiles`, `/api/v1/crops/{cropId}/insights`, `/api/v1/ai/learning`, `/api/v1/overview`, `/api/v1/overview/series`, `/api/v1/overview/fleet`
- Alerts, Channels & Connections: `/api/v1/notifications`, `/api/v1/notifications/unread-count`, `/api/v1/channels`, `/api/v1/connections`

## MCP Tools (`SmartPot-MCP`)

Authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer spt_...` (`READ` or `CONTROL` scope):

- Account & Crops: `get_account`, `list_crops`, `get_crop`, `create_crop`, `update_crop`, `delete_crop`, `set_crop_automation`, `get_crop_weather`
- Telemetry: `get_latest_reading`, `get_readings_history`, `get_readings_summary`, `record_reading`
- Actuators & Commands: `list_actuators`, `send_actuator_command`, `send_bulk_command`, `list_commands`
- AI & Fleet Overview: `get_crop_insights`, `get_crop_profiles`, `get_learning_status`, `get_overview`, `get_metric_series`, `get_fleet`
- Notifications: `list_notifications`, `get_unread_count`, `mark_notification_read`

## Public Web Routes

- `/` — Platform overview, interactive assistant demo, species reference ranges, and FAQ.
- `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password` — Authentication pages (`noindex, follow`).
